title: An Empirical Study of the Anchoring Effect in LLMs: Existence, Mechanism, and Potential Mitigations
reasoning: The paper investigates the anchoring effect, which is a cognitive bias from psychology. While the study situates itself within 'trustworthy AI' research and mentions safety tests, it focuses on the psychological mechanics of numerical and semantic priming rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, spiritual traditions, theology, or specific ethical/moral frameworks.
